node.title: Re: Printing from a hash table
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You can use [doc://defined] to test for undef and [doc://length] to test for empty strings, and then either use an if to exclude those values like you're already using, or as an alternative use [doc://next] to skip the current iteration of the loop.

By the way, [doc://keys] only returns the keys that already exist in the hash, so your [doc://exists] check isn't necesary in this case.
